description: Create repository-owned synthetic mock-indexer and protocol-fault services for deterministic timeout, malformed-response, unsupported-version, unavailable-service, and stale-readback tests.
acceptance: Responses and timing are deterministic and use only minimal synthetic fields.
Scenarios cover timeout, unavailable service, malformed JSON, unsupported API version, and stale readback.
Doubles cannot reach the internet, expose host ports, or receive Docker authority.
Logs redact headers, cookies, query parameters, and secret-like values.
Repository source contains no copied upstream UI assets, databases, media metadata, or full captured responses.
